messages:
maria: Heads-up — targeting 03:30 PT deploy for model routing change. Quick sync: who owns kill-switch mapping, smoke checks, and the rollback decision? Need clear criteria before we push.
sam: I can own kill-switch mapping. Will map toggles -> region -> model-variant. Plan: ramp in 2 stages with toggle names routing_canary_{region}. Will post mapping in a sec.
sam: ```
# listing toggles for this deploy
redctl toggle list routing.canary.*
# flip example
redctl toggle set routing.override.us-west legacy
```
leah: I'll own service-side smoke. Quick thresholds: 99p latency < 250ms, 95p < 150ms, 5xx rate < 0.3%, overall error rate < 0.5% (5m window). If any break for >2 consecutive 1m windows -> rollback.
noah: I'm oncall for rollback ops. Runbook is here: https://wiki.redwoodinternal/runbooks/rollback-deploy. Escape-hatch mapping: kill-switch -> legacy-router fallback. I'll be available for 30m post-deploy.
maria: What's the exact command to flip the kill-switch? Need runbook snippet for quick action.
sam: Command (copy/paste): ```redctl toggle set routing.override.<region> legacy``` I'll paste the snippet into the runbook and the deploy playbook.
deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled 03:30 PT. Canary starts at 03:32 PT; will announce canary completion and health.
leah: Smoke checklist (short):
1) ./smoke-tests/health.sh -> exit 0
2) validate traces for tail lat spikes
3) check per-route 5xx and client error rates
4) KV cache hit rate should not drop >5%
5) confirm router qps ~= expected baseline
If all green for 10m -> proceed.
maria: Go/no-go: pass smoke 10m + no 5xx > 0.3% and no 99p regressions beyond threshold -> roll to 50% for 15m, then full. Approve?
noah: +1 from ops. I'll coordinate infra to reserve extra capacity and pre-warm nodes.
sam: Mapping doc uploaded: https://files.redwood/internal/deploys/1918887776-mapping.md
leah: I'll watch traces and metrics dashboards. Ping me if 95p increases >40% or token tail latency spikes.
maria: Owners please be present in channel during deploy. React with :eyes: if you can stay.
noah: :eyes:
sam: :eyes:
leah: :thumbsup:
maria: Locking criteria and owners. Starting on schedule unless someone objects. Close this thread unless anything changes.
